findings.location: Multiple paragraph blocks containing quoted Scripture (Genesis 2:18-24; Genesis 1:26-28; Genesis 2:22-23; Genesis 2:24; Mark 10:7; Mark 10:8-9; 2 Corinthians 6:14-15; 1 Corinthians 7:39; Genesis 1:28; Genesis 9:1; Genesis 9:7; 1 Corinthians 11:3; Ephesians 6:1-3; Proverbs 3:1-2; Ephesians 5:21,22,24; Ephesians 5:25,28,29; Ephesians 5:33; 1 Peter 3:7; Psalm 144:12; Ephesians 5:24-29), e.g. paragraphs starting with: “And the LORD God said, It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him an help meet for him...” and several others.
findings.source_quote: (Example) “And the LORD God said, It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him an help meet for him...”(Genesis 2:18-24) — many other scripture quotations remain in English throughout the article.
findings.suggested_fix: Translate each quoted Scripture passage into Portuguese so it conveys the printed English quotation in the target language, keeping the original verse citations in parentheses. For example replace the Genesis 2:18-24 block with a Portuguese rendering such as: “E o SENHOR Deus disse: Não é bom que o homem esteja só; far‑lhe‑ei uma ajudadora idônea. E formou o SENHOR Deus da terra todo o animal do campo... Portanto deixará o homem seu pai e sua mãe, e unir‑se‑á a sua mulher, e serão ambos uma carne” (Gênesis 2:18‑24). Apply the same treatment to every other English scripture quotation present. Preserve existing HTML tags and verse citation punctuation exactly as in source.
findings.translation_quote: (Example) “And the LORD God said, It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him an help meet for him...”(Genesis 2:18-24) — and many other scripture quotations remain in English in the translation.

findings.location: Paragraphs where verse citations are left in English but surrounding explanatory sentences are in Portuguese, e.g. references to Ephesians: “Ephesians 5:21,22,24 says, “Submitting yourselves one to another in the fear of God...”
findings.source_quote: Ephesians 5:21,22,24 says, “Submitting yourselves one to another in the fear of God...”
findings.suggested_fix: Convert the leading English reference phrase and the quoted text into Portuguese to match the surrounding translation. Example: “Efésios 5:21,22,24 diz: ‘Sujeitai‑vos uns aos outros no temor de Deus. Mulheres, sujeitai‑vos a vossos próprios maridos, como ao Senhor...’” Keep the HTML structure intact.
findings.translation_quote: Ephesians 5:21,22,24 says, “Submitting yourselves one to another in the fear of God. Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as unto the Lord. . . Therefore as the church is subject unto Christ, so let the wives be to their own husbands in every thing.”
